units_and_scope.hamiltonian: Periodic one-dimensional Bose–Hubbard rings, t=1, N=L, inclusive nmax=6; U_phys/t is 2 (SF), 3.275 (BKT), 8 (Mott).
units_and_scope.mps_brackets: Open lower endpoint is a certified miss, closed upper endpoint is a tested pass. Endpoints use achieved chi. Margins include reference and, where required, same-cap sweep stability.
units_and_scope.ed_screen: Full fixed-sector positive squared fidelity. Three confirmation seeds; median infidelity <=0.001 required in every phase at each size. <=0.0001 is the tight target. Fresh Mott fits are separate from the archived strict replays.
units_and_scope.physical_gate: Absolute E/L tolerance 0.001 in hopping units; G1(r) tolerance 0.05*abs(reference)+0.0005. Margins and conservative intervals are applied. Both independent terminal tests must pass all required observables and two of three training seeds must pass for a cohort.
units_and_scope.cost: Only tested terminal budgets are classified. Training and frozen evaluation are separate, and FLOP values are estimates. GPU fixed-update arms were planned around 310 update seconds.
units_and_scope.k_eff: Historical, finite-size two-point diagnostic. The VMC number_variance_l trace averages squared deviations from the unit-filling block mean l. The DMRG connected estimator subtracts the mean at each block placement. They agree at uniform mean density; otherwise static density inhomogeneity can contribute to the VMC trace.
units_and_scope.sources: Keys shared with result sections resolve to archived artifact basename, SHA-256, and Slurm job IDs. Where supplied, archive_subdirectory is relative to the run directory.

preholdout.fit_method: All pairwise log-space interval constraints for a shared amplitude and exponent, without regression on passing caps.
preholdout.early_holdout_exposure: Earlier exploratory L64 measurements appeared in archived coverage and preview outputs. This report uses only L16–L48 fit constraints and labels L64 values as predictions.

2.saturation_scope: The constant test covers only the listed fit sizes. A plateau may start at a larger size.

3.275.saturation_scope: The constant test covers only the listed fit sizes. A plateau may start at a larger size.
